bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12" x 12" x 6" and small bags up to 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed at Huntington Bank Field.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 12" x 6"
Small non-clear bags up to 4.5" x 6.5"
Diaper, nursing and medical bags after inspection
prohibited: Any bag larger than 12" x 6" x 12"
bagPolicy.note: Each person may carry one clear bag and one small clutch. Diaper, nursing and medical bags use the medical exception entrances at the Southwest or Southeast Canada Dry City Club entrance. Bag Check Tent at the southwest corner costs $20 per bag, credit card only, with pickup within 30 minutes after the event. Permitted items may vary for concerts, so check the event page.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Huntington Bank Field can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Arrange pickup and drop-off on Lakeside Avenue between West 3rd Street and East 9th Street. Vehicle access near the stadium is restricted for at least one hour after events.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Huntington Bank Field varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Contact the Ticketmaster Ticket Office at (440) 891-5050 ahead of time for accessible seating. Limited ADA relocations are offered at Guest Services on event day. Service animals are welcome, and private sensory rooms are at sections 118, 349, and 514.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: You cannot leave and return using the same ticket. Speak to a security supervisor at the gate for a medical emergency.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Ticketmaster Ticket Office is located on the south side of the stadium next to the Pro Shop.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Nine entrances serve the stadium, including the Meijer Gate, University Hospitals Gate, Huntington Bank Ramp/Gate, Northeast Ramp/Gate, and North Grand Staircase for general admission. The SE and SW Canada Dry City Club entrances are open to all guests, including fans with disabilities. For Browns games, gates open two hours before kickoff. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
